headline: Join brief — Acme verified-domain onboarding week one
body: Verify DNS-TXT on acme.example, leave join policy on admin_approval, and walk the first ten joiners through the Team Board.
author: Ava Admin

headline: Onboarding guide — first day after domain join lands
body: Confirm member role, star the all-hands post, and open join readiness so you know DNS and policy status without leaving home.
author: Ava Admin

headline: Join playbook — admin_approval queue for new work emails
body: Review each join request against verified domain, reject personal domains, and post welcome notes only after membership is granted.
author: Ava Admin

headline: Policy — guest wifi rotation stays out of the join roster
body: SSID cutovers are announced on the board; never grant workspace membership solely because someone knows the guest password.
author: Ava Admin

headline: Decision — freeze auto-join until two weeks of clean DNS
body: Keep admin_approval for fourteen days after TXT goes green; only then evaluate open join for trusted engineering teams.
author: Ava Admin

headline: Join brief — Northwind kickoff logistics for domain join
body: northwind.example opens Monday under admin_approval; ops posts kickoff logistics before any joiners land on the board.
author: Nora Northwind

headline: Onboarding guide — Northwind member feed after join
body: New members land on Team Board; open workspace documents first so handbook and policy are visible before discussion notes.
author: Nora Northwind

headline: Join playbook — contractor emails require manual review
body: Reject non-northwind domains; for contractors, create a time-boxed guest announcement instead of permanent membership.
author: Nora Northwind

headline: Policy — announcement posts stay inside current_tenant fence
body: Never cross-post Acme bodies into Northwind; each announcement and document is scoped to its workspace tenant root.
author: Ava Admin

headline: Join playbook — DNS-TXT recheck after registrar change
body: After any DNS provider move, re-run dazzle auth domain verify and pause join approvals until TXT matches again.
author: Ava Admin

headline: Decision — Northwind keeps admin_approval through kickoff week
body: No open join during kickoff; ops approves only named leads so logistics posts stay readable and the roster stays intentional.
author: Nora Northwind

headline: Brief draft — handbook cutover for remote policy Q3
body: Draft remote policy links go through Publish desk first; document status stays draft until legal and IT both sign off.
author: Ava Admin
